description.p: Downloads bank statements from Česká spořitelna (CSAS) and imports the bank movements into the Pohoda accounting software through mServer. Features:

ul.li: Statements for a date range or a symbolic period such as last month
Idempotent import, already imported movements are skipped
Optional upload of the statements to SharePoint and attaching their links to the bank records in Pohoda
JSON report with a console log of every run

description.p: Rewritten in PHP, optional SharePoint upload and links in Pohoda, report and console log of every run.
